pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0127 first-release completion on the existing Draft PR. Integrates Native 2D asset kinds, Camera2D/SpriteRenderer2D/SpriteAnimator2D built-in components and scene conversion, deterministic fixed-step sprite animation runtime, and shared Camera2D/Camera3D priority ambiguity diagnostics while preserving the current dedicated 2D physics implementation.

This request intentionally does not revive stale PR #242 or replace merged 2D physics/project-settings contracts.
